---
title: How tea and coffee keep you awake
kind: contrast
domain: beverages
---
## Essence
Coffee wakes you up fast; tea wakes you up slowly.

## Propositions
- P1. A cup of coffee has more caffeine than a cup of tea, so it acts faster.
- P2. The theanine in tea makes the caffeine act more slowly.
